title: Poppy motif
subtitle: A four-petal poppy in red with a black centre, 10 cm
excerpt: The poppy is a bold four-petal motif with broadly ruffled petals and a small black dc centre. Each petal is a separate piece worked in dc with increase rows to a rounded tip, then decrease back to the base. Four petals are joined at the base around a 6-dc centre ring. The finished motif at 10 cm in red DK is striking and immediately recognisable.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 6 (1891), poppy and large flower motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886), crochet poppy and rose construction.
heroPrompt: A crochet poppy motif in bright red DK cotton with four broad petals and a small black centre disc, 10 cm across, photographed flat on natural linen in soft daylight.

crochet.gaugeText: Each finished poppy motif measures 10 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Poppy motif
chartDefinition.caption: Centre: 6dc magic ring in black. Four separate petals worked flat; petals sewn onto centre. Each petal: 6-row flat shape widening to 10dc and narrowing back to 6dc.

glossaryTerms.definition: An adjustable starting loop that pulls closed to leave no visible centre hole. Used for the poppy's black centre disc.

content.text: The poppy works four separate petals then assembles them around a tight

centre disc. Each petal is a flat dc shape: a chain foundation, increase rows to the widest point, even rows, then decrease rows back to the base. The four petals are sewn evenly around the centre in a cross formation.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 12 g of red DK cotton, 2 g of black. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished poppy motif measures 10 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.
Form a magic ring. Ch 1. 6dc into ring. Sl st to join. Rnd 2: 2dc in each. Sl st to join. (12 dc.) Fasten off, leaving a 20 cm tail for assembly.

Ch 8. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across. (6 dc.) Turn. Row 2: Ch 1. 2dc. Dc across to last. 2dc. (8 dc.) Turn. Row 3: Ch 1. 2dc. Dc across to last. 2dc. (10 dc.) Turn. Rows 4-5: Ch 1. Dc across even. Turn. Row 6: Ch 1. Dc2tog. Dc across to last 2. Dc2tog. (8 dc.) Turn. Row 7: Dc2tog. Dc across. Dc2tog. (6 dc.) Fasten off with 20 cm tail.
Sew the narrow base of each petal to the centre disc at equally spaced positions (every 3rd dc on the 12-dc ring). The four petals should fan outward like a compass rose.

definition.title: Poppy motif
definition.caption: Black centre: 12dc magic ring. Red petals x4: 7-row flat shape from 6dc to 10dc and back to 6dc. Petals sewn evenly around centre.

content.text: Weave in all ends. The petals can be lightly steam-blocked open. Sew the assembled poppy onto the base fabric through the outer edge of the centre disc.
Handwash with the base fabric in cool water. Lay flat to dry.
The violet (crochet-flower-violet) uses a five-petal version of the same construction at a smaller scale. The cherry blossom (crochet-flower-cherry-blossom) adds a picot edge to each petal.
